from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Retain uniform lines that function as internal separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r in sep_rows if 0 < r < h-1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in sep_cols if 0 < c < w-1]
    rseps = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cseps = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    blocks = [(range(rseps[i]+1, rseps[i+1]), range(cseps[j]+1, cseps[j+1]))
              for i in range(len(rseps)-1) for j in range(len(cseps)-1)]
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for rs,cs in blocks for r in rs for c in cs)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for rs,cs in blocks:
        n=sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in rs for c in cs)
        out.append(1 if n > 1 else bg)
    nr=len(rseps)-1; nc=len(cseps)-1
    return [out[i*nc:(i+1)*nc] for i in range(nr)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and 0 < r < h - 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and 0 < c < w - 1]
    rseps = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cseps = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    blocks = [
        (range(rseps[i] + 1, rseps[i + 1]), range(cseps[j] + 1, cseps[j + 1]))
        for i in range(len(rseps) - 1)
        for j in range(len(cseps) - 1)
    ]
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for rows, cols in blocks for r in rows for c in cols)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells = [
        1 if sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in rows for c in cols) > 1 else background
        for rows, cols in blocks
    ]
    ncols = len(cseps) - 1
    return [cells[i * ncols:(i + 1) * ncols] for i in range(len(rseps) - 1)]
